## EnergyGrid invoice delivery boundary (inactive)

The authenticated loopback webhook accepts exactly one multipart text field named metadata and one PDF binary field named pdf. Metadata is a JSON string with the eight exact keys from energygrid.invoice_delivery.v1. Duplicate metadata keys, extra text fields, duplicate or extra binary files, mismatched filename, MIME, size or hash, and non-PDF bytes are rejected. Crypto hashes actual PDF bytes; Merge restores the validated binary for email. Success and error execution payloads are not saved.

A Data Table is a secondary ledger keyed by delivery_id. Create columns delivery_id, run_id, stream, bill_date, attachment_name, pdf_sha256, pdf_byte_size, state, support_ref. Get and Insert are not atomic and provide no global concurrency control. Local SQLite write-once dispatch remains the only send permission. Send Email never retries; the success path reads back and verifies the bounded DELIVERED row before responding. A send error is recorded as DELIVERY_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN before the bounded 503 response. Existing or uncertain deliveries are never resent.

Bind Header Auth and SMTP credentials, replace the webhook path, Data Table ID, approved sender and recipient only in an authorised local import copy. Keep the webhook on loopback. This inactive export is design evidence, not proof of import, activation, or execution.
